PSALM CXIX. VER. 144.
The Righteousness of thy Testimonies is Everlasting, give me Understanding and I shall live.
First. The Excellency of the Word is again acknowledged, The Righteousness of thy Testimonies is Everlasting.
Secondly. A Prayer is thereupon grounded, give me Understanding.

Thirdly. The Fruit and Benefit of being heard in that Prayer, and I shall Live. Because the Righteousness of the Word is Everlasting, therefore we should beg Understanding, and this sound Understanding maketh way for Life.

First. He beginneth with the Praise of the Word; the Righteousness of thy testimonies. The Word of God is contemned by none but such as know not the Excellency of it, both in its own nature, and the fruits of it. The sum of the whole Octonary is here repeated.
